# Features and maturity

Outpost is pre-release. Maturity records the strongest relevant evidence category; it is
not a claim that every lower category is complete. `Production-ready` requires an
explicit release decision and is never inferred from test count alone.

Evidence snapshot: **2026-08-28**. Verification commit `HEAD` means the exact
revision on which CI runs this manifest check.

## Maturity states

| State | Definition |
| --- | --- |
| Designed | Behavior and safety boundaries are specified, but an operator-usable implementation is not present. |
| Implemented | The capability is present in code; complete automated behavior coverage is not yet recorded. |
| Automated-tested | Unit, integration, acceptance, or browser tests exercise the capability and its important failure boundaries. |
| Simulated | The complete workflow passed with simulated clocks, radios, providers, peers, or failures; a relevant field gate remains open. |
| Single-node field-tested | A recorded run passed on one physical Outpost or its attached field hardware. |
| Two-node field-tested | A recorded workflow passed between two physical Outposts, including the stated transport and recovery conditions. |
| Hardware-gated | A capability-specific hardware acceptance gate passed on the recorded target; broader soak or deployment gates may remain. |
| Production-ready | A release decision explicitly accepted all required safety, compatibility, recovery, field, and operational evidence. |

## Evidence and limitations

### Meshtastic transport

Maturity: **Single-node field-tested**.

Evidence:

- Automated: [tests/unit/test_radio_link.py](../tests/unit/test_radio_link.py) — Link lifecycle, packet handling, and failure normalization.
- Field: [docs/FEDERATION-ACCEPTANCE-BACKLOG.md](FEDERATION-ACCEPTANCE-BACKLOG.md) — Live radio traffic and recovery were exercised between physical Outposts.

Known limitations:

- Serial and live LoRa paths have field evidence; TCP and BLE remain primarily automated-test paths.
- Extended unplug, range, busy-channel, and unattended-soak gates remain open.

### Command routing

Maturity: **Automated-tested**.

Evidence:

- Automated: [tests/acceptance/test_phase1_acceptance.py](../tests/acceptance/test_phase1_acceptance.py) — Phase 1 command and radio-response behavior.
- Automated: [tests/integration/test_inbound_workers.py](../tests/integration/test_inbound_workers.py) — Bounded concurrency, backpressure, and drop telemetry.
- Automated: [tests/integration/test_mesh_tui.py](../tests/integration/test_mesh_tui.py) — First-class mesh journeys, capability and trust filtering, interruption recovery, guided composition, and packet budgets.
- Automated: [tests/integration/test_mesh_pki_trust.py](../tests/integration/test_mesh_pki_trust.py) — Direct authenticated command gates, downgrade denial, key conflict demotion, explicit rotation, and durable replay rejection.

Known limitations:

- The full handheld/firmware/preset matrix is not field-qualified.

### Airtime and outbound delivery

Maturity: **Automated-tested**.

Evidence:

- Automated: [tests/integration/test_durable_outbox.py](../tests/integration/test_durable_outbox.py) — Admitted work survives restart and delivery state is idempotent.
- Automated: [tests/unit/test_governor.py](../tests/unit/test_governor.py) — Priority, budget, reserve, pacing, and failure-path policy.

Known limitations:

### Outpost federation

Maturity: **Two-node field-tested**.

Evidence:

- Field: [docs/FEDERATION-ACCEPTANCE-BACKLOG.md](FEDERATION-ACCEPTANCE-BACKLOG.md) — Recorded two-Outpost pairing, radio sync, recovery, mail, privacy, and rejection probes.
- Automated: [tests/integration/test_federation_sync.py](../tests/integration/test_federation_sync.py) — Bounded synchronization and reconciliation behavior.
- Automated: [tests/integration/test_incident_reconciliation.py](../tests/integration/test_incident_reconciliation.py) — Origin-aware partition/reconnect conflict reconciliation and human merge correction.
- Automated: [tests/integration/test_federation_relay.py](../tests/integration/test_federation_relay.py) — Signed three-node custody, direct-path selection, duplicate/reconnect safety, malicious-input rejection, quotas, receipts, and operator controls.
- Operations: [docs/FEDERATION-RELAY-PROTOCOL.md](FEDERATION-RELAY-PROTOCOL.md) — Relay threat model, protocol bounds, confidentiality limits, resource policy, and operator runbook.
- Automated: [tests/integration/test_federation_topology.py](../tests/integration/test_federation_topology.py) — Privacy-gated coarse location exchange, health paths/backlog, stale state, successors, tombstones, and safe API output.
- Operations: [docs/FEDERATION-TOPOLOGY.md](FEDERATION-TOPOLOGY.md) — Location privacy boundary, identity states, health derivation, offline behavior, and operator workflow.

Known limitations:

- MQTT-only traffic/fallback and destructive quota exhaustion remain open.
- Signed multi-hop custody is simulation-tested; physical three-node and power-loss exercises remain open.
- Topology location exchange is automated-tested; physical multi-node and long-duration stale/recovery exercises remain open.
- Federation remains experimental until every acceptance-backlog item passes.

## Global boundaries

- No 1.0 compatibility promise exists yet.
- Automated or simulated evidence does not replace radio-range, power-loss, thermal,
  security, or disaster exercises on the deployment hardware.
- Environmental feeds are informational and retain source timestamps.
- Emergency keyword matching remains off by default because both false positives and
  missed detections are safety risks.
